note: Display strings only (docs/12). A theme may change nothing the simulation can observe: none of this reaches state_checksum or content_hash, and editing this file cannot invalidate the trace corpus. Array index is identity, exactly as in content.json.

weapons.name: Bow
weapons.flavor: Warden issue, third pattern; the stock is notched once for every gunner the Pale Wardens lost holding this same dirt.
weapons.tip: Single-target piercing. The first thing they hand you, and often the last.

weapons.name: Mortar Launcher
weapons.flavor: Ninth Foundry overrun, its sights still ground for a wall that no longer stands at Ashmark.
weapons.tip: Lobbed siege splash. Wide blast, slow to reseat.

weapons.name: Frost Bow
weapons.flavor: The cold it throws is the same cold that took Ashmark in one night; the Hexwrights only learned to aim it afterward.
weapons.tip: Fast single-target magic. Stacks frost toward the freeze.

weapons.name: Poison Bow
weapons.flavor: Greycoat field-rations went bad in the same crates that carried these tips, and the quartermaster shipped both anyway.
weapons.tip: Single-target piercing. Light hit, heavy poison rot.

weapons.name: Flamecaster
weapons.flavor: Foundry-work turned outward; the men who pour the cannon learned long ago that fire spreads down a packed column.
weapons.tip: Short-range chaos splash. Stacks fire that cooks, then bursts on death.

weapons.name: Storm Hammer
weapons.flavor: The Hexwrights bound a storm into the head and never told the Wardens how to put it down.
weapons.tip: Heavy single-target magic. Long stun on the target.

weapons.name: Ballista
weapons.flavor: Stamped at the Ninth Foundry, four-bolt pattern, built for a frontier that needed walls cleared faster than it had men.
weapons.tip: Long-range siege barrage. Four bolts to four targets.

weapons.name: Immolation
weapons.flavor: Wardens who stood too long beside a failing reactor learned to wear the burn; this makes a weapon of it.
weapons.tip: Chaos area pulse around the tank. Stacks fire on everything near.

weapons.name: Shockwave Axe
weapons.flavor: Salvaged off the Ashmark sappers, who swung once and let the ground carry the rest of the argument.
weapons.tip: Point-blank normal wave. Big sweeping hit, nothing applied.

weapons.name: Moon Glaive
weapons.flavor: A Hexwright trinket that does its own targeting; the Conclave swears it was never meant to leave the vault.
weapons.tip: Single-target piercing chain. Bounces to four enemies.

weapons.name: Death Engine
weapons.flavor: The Foundry built one and then could not stop building it; each copy makes the next cheaper to feed.
weapons.tip: Single-target chaos. Damage compounds per Death Engine owned.

weapons.name: Magic Missile
weapons.flavor: First rite the Conclave teaches its apprentices, and the last thing a great many things ever saw.
weapons.tip: Single-target magic. Plain bolt, no status.

weapons.name: Boulder
weapons.flavor: A rock the Greycoats no longer had to carry, thrown at a problem they no longer had to name.
weapons.tip: Single-target siege. Heavy stone, no status.

weapons.name: Magic Bolt
weapons.flavor: Conclave-cut and clean, with none of the frost or fire the Hexwrights add when they want to be remembered.
weapons.tip: Single-target magic. Quick, plain hit.

weapons.name: Chaos Orb
weapons.flavor: Whatever the Conclave sealed in here predates the war, and it leaves armor unconvinced.
weapons.tip: Single-target chaos. Ignores armor type.

weapons.name: Throwing Axes
weapons.flavor: Greycoat sidearms, three to a belt, meant for the work that happens after the line already broke.
weapons.tip: Short-range piercing chain. Fast, bounces to three.

weapons.name: Chaos Skulls
weapons.flavor: The Conclave renders down the heads of its own dead and stuffs them with worse; they remember whose they were.
weapons.tip: Chaos chain. Bounces between three bodies.

weapons.name: Suckula
weapons.flavor: Suckula sleeps all day and feasts all night; every bite it lands comes straight back to you as a little more life.
weapons.tip: Heavy point-blank chaos wave. Slow, vampiric on the base item.

weapons.name: Missile Barrage
weapons.flavor: Eight tubes off the Ashmark batteries, recovered from a position that fired this volley once and was overrun anyway.
weapons.tip: Epic long-range piercing barrage. Eight bolts, each stuns.

weapons.name: Seeker Axe
weapons.flavor: A Warden glaive cut to find its mark across the open ground command never reinforced.
weapons.tip: Long-range piercing chain. Bounces to three.

weapons.name: Steam Cannon
weapons.flavor: Ninth Foundry pressure-rig, the kind that scalds the loader as readily as the target.
weapons.tip: Short-range siege splash. Brief stun on hit.

weapons.name: Demon Eye
weapons.flavor: The Conclave does not say where this eye came from, only that it chooses, and the choosing is final.
weapons.tip: Heavy single-target chaos. Pure punch, no status.

weapons.name: Impaler
weapons.flavor: Warden spearwork, made for the press at the wire where there is no room to miss.
weapons.tip: Fast single-target piercing. Short stun.

weapons.name: Chaos Swarm
weapons.flavor: A Hexwright cloud of small wrong things, loosed long over the Ashmark dead and quiet after.
weapons.tip: Long-range chaos splash. Spreads on impact.

weapons.name: Catapult
weapons.flavor: Foundry stonework, short-ranged and unsubtle, built for a line that had run out of subtler answers.
weapons.tip: Short-range siege single-target. Heavy stone.

weapons.name: Slap
weapons.flavor: One enormous open-palm Slap, delivered with the full indignation of a creature that was having a perfectly nice day.
weapons.tip: Epic single-target piercing. Enormous hit, no status.

weapons.name: Crippler
weapons.flavor: The Greycoats took to calling this one mercy and kept walking; whatever it touches stops being a leg.
weapons.tip: Heavy single-target piercing. Lasting wound on the base item.

weapons.name: Lifeleecher
weapons.flavor: A Warden exotic that takes from the wrong end of the wound and gives it back to the gunner.
weapons.tip: Long-range normal single-target. Feeds you on the base item.

weapons.name: Spell Glaive
weapons.flavor: Conclave-honed thought given an edge, cutting outbound and again on the return.
weapons.tip: Magic chain. Carves through four.

weapons.name: Glaive Thrower
weapons.flavor: No Hexwright trick on this one, just Foundry steel that refuses to lie where it lands.
weapons.tip: Normal chain. Bounces to three.

weapons.name: Spikewheel Launcher
weapons.flavor: Spikewheel off the Ashmark works, set rolling once and never minded the men behind it.
weapons.tip: Long-range siege chain. Bounces through six.

weapons.name: Meatapult
weapons.flavor: Whatever the Greycoats could not bury, they loaded; the ledger lists it as ammunition.
weapons.tip: Normal splash. Heavy impact, brief stun.

weapons.name: Arcane Blaster
weapons.flavor: Conclave hardware that discharges clean and leaves the smell on the air longer than the target.
weapons.tip: Single-target magic. Stuns on hit.

weapons.name: Quills
weapons.flavor: Barbs the Greycoats scavenged off something the Conclave should have burned, each one a small lasting debt.
weapons.tip: Single-target piercing. Light poison rot.

weapons.name: Living Spittle
weapons.flavor: A Hexwright thing that lands still living, briefly, and leaves the target the same way.
weapons.tip: Single-target magic. Trickling poison.

weapons.name: Poison Bomb
weapons.flavor: Foundry shell packed over a Greycoat sickness, so the crater goes on killing after the blast is done.
weapons.tip: Siege splash. Poisons the whole crater.

weapons.name: Serpent
weapons.flavor: One bite, by a thing the Conclave bred and refuses to account for; the rest is only the waiting.
weapons.tip: Single-target normal. Strong poison rot.

weapons.name: Overloaded Catapult
weapons.flavor: They told it the safe load at the Ninth Foundry, and the catapult overruled them in stone.
weapons.tip: Heavy siege splash. Bigger rock, bigger hole.

weapons.name: Chaos Claw
weapons.flavor: A Conclave reach out of nowhere that closes on whatever the gunner could least spare.
weapons.tip: Single-target chaos. Stuns on hit.

weapons.name: Net Thrower
weapons.flavor: Greycoat netting, weighted and thrown, because a thing on the floor counting threads is a thing not at the wire.
weapons.tip: Fast long-range normal single-target. Tangling stun.

weapons.name: Thornburst
weapons.flavor: The Hexwrights seeded this ground and walked away; what grew has its own opinion about trespass.
weapons.tip: Wide piercing area pulse. Hits everything near.

weapons.name: Chaotic Spirit
weapons.flavor: A Conclave spirit that died once already and took the lesson badly, loosed to chain through a column.
weapons.tip: Epic magic chain. Wails through eight.

weapons.name: Energy Pulse
weapons.flavor: A Hexwright reactor's exhale, a clean white nothing the Wardens learned to point downrange.
weapons.tip: Point-blank magic wave. Sweeps wide, stuns.

weapons.name: Cluster Rockets
weapons.flavor: A full rack of Ninth Foundry warheads, every casing serial-stamped and none of them aimed at anyone in particular.
weapons.tip: Long chaos barrage. Twelve warheads to scattered targets, no status.

weapons.name: Frost Bomb
weapons.flavor: The Hexwrights bottled the night Ashmark froze and packed it behind a fuse.
weapons.tip: Fast piercing splash. Stacks frost on the cluster.

weapons.name: Bouncy Cannonball
weapons.flavor: A Foundry reject that never machined round, so the Greycoats let it loose to crack heads instead.
weapons.tip: Normal bounce. Four hops, each stuns.

weapons.name: Soulstealer
weapons.flavor: The Pale Wardens cut this from the field after the Relief failed to come, and it has been hungry since.
weapons.tip: Epic normal bounce. Chains four; feeds the tank.

weapons.name: Splasher
weapons.flavor: Foundry-town surplus by the crateload, cheap enough that the quartermaster stopped counting them.
weapons.tip: Fast normal splash. Rapid small bursts, no status.

weapons.name: Fire Bow
weapons.flavor: Warden arrows wrapped in Foundry pitch, lit one rank at a time the way the line always burns.
weapons.tip: Piercing barrage. Four shots, each stacks fire.

weapons.name: Chaos Web
weapons.flavor: The Conclave strung this between the Ashmark dead and called the rot it leaves a side effect.
weapons.tip: Chaos bounce. Six links; leaves poison.

weapons.name: Magic Claw
weapons.flavor: Hexwright work meant for close quarters, borrowing more power than the gunner can hold.
weapons.tip: Short magic bounce. Chains four.

weapons.name: Liquid Fire Hurler
weapons.flavor: Ladled straight from a Ninth Foundry crucible and slung before it cools.
weapons.tip: Fast siege single-target. Stacks fire.

weapons.name: Boulder Toss
weapons.flavor: Catapult ammunition the Greycoats stripped from Ashmark's broken walls and lobbed back.
weapons.tip: Short normal splash. Crushing impact, no status.

weapons.name: Bloody Spikes
weapons.flavor: The Wardens worked these into the dirt of the last yard the night before they were overrun.
weapons.tip: Epic normal wave. Heavy sweep; stuns.

weapons.name: Shroom Doom
weapons.flavor: Shroom Doom seeds a whole patch of angry caps; they pop in a chain, and what survives the blast gets up as your Spores.
weapons.tip: Epic chaos pulse. Massive fire stacks; stuns.

weapons.name: Flame Generator
weapons.flavor: The Ninth Foundry never meant for one furnace to feed a whole field, but the war stopped asking.
weapons.tip: Epic magic pulse. Buries a pack in fire stacks.

weapons.name: Firebreather
weapons.flavor: Standard Foundry issue for the front rank, where the line meets the dark and rarely holds.
weapons.tip: Fast piercing splash. Stacks fire.

weapons.name: Lavaspitter
weapons.flavor: The Foundry-towns tap the deep crucibles for this, and what it spits keeps burning long after Ashmark's example.
weapons.tip: Epic long siege splash. Heavy fire stacks.

weapons.name: Frostbolt
weapons.flavor: A single sliver of the cold that took Ashmark, fired again and again until something stops.
weapons.tip: Fast piercing single-target. Stacks frost.

weapons.name: Living Ice
weapons.flavor: Conclave frost that does not wait to be aimed; it spreads the way the Ashmark winter spread.
weapons.tip: Magic splash. Spreads frost on impact.

weapons.name: Ice Generator
weapons.flavor: The Hexwrights bound a piece of that killing winter to a frame and could never make it stop.
weapons.tip: Epic magic pulse. Frosts a huge radius toward freeze.

weapons.name: Ice Spears
weapons.flavor: Ashmark-cold shards racked by the Greycoats, four to a volley, ledgered by the dozen.
weapons.tip: Normal barrage. Four hits, each stacks frost.

weapons.name: Knives
weapons.flavor: The first thing the quartermaster hands a green Greycoat, and the cheapest line in the ledger.
weapons.tip: Fast piercing barrage. Three blades, no status.

weapons.name: Blaster
weapons.flavor: Blunt Foundry overrun, loud and serial-stamped, sold by weight to the Wardens.
weapons.tip: Fast siege single-target. No status.

weapons.name: Bandit Sniper
weapons.flavor: A Greycoat deserter's rifle, recovered from Ashmark with the scope still sighted on a fleeing back.
weapons.tip: Fast long normal single-target. No status.

weapons.name: Bombs
weapons.flavor: Ninth Foundry charges that the Greycoats lob underhand and never look back at.
weapons.tip: Short siege splash. Brief stun.

weapons.name: Sting
weapons.flavor: A single precise Sting from a very small, very offended thing — and suddenly the target is taking everyone's hits much harder.
weapons.tip: Long chaos single-target. No status.

weapons.name: Chaos Skull Bomb
weapons.flavor: Somebody's skull, packed by the Greycoats with worse and stamped for the line.
weapons.tip: Chaos splash. Bursts and stuns.

weapons.name: Icebreather
weapons.flavor: Foundry casings charged with Ashmark's leftover cold, breathed out across the crater.
weapons.tip: Siege splash. Frosts the blast.

weapons.name: Frostwave
weapons.flavor: The Conclave sends the cold out in a line now, the way the news of Ashmark traveled the front.
weapons.tip: Magic wave. Sweeps and frosts.

weapons.name: Flamewave
weapons.flavor: A wall of Foundry-fire walked forward across the dirt, the way the line is supposed to and no longer can.
weapons.tip: Normal wave. Sweeps; heavy fire stacks.

weapons.name: Chaotic Spirit Bolt
weapons.flavor: A Hexwright spark that flickers out and carries a sliver of the gunner back with each kill.
weapons.tip: Fast chaos single-target. Heals the tank.

weapons.name: Manabolt
weapons.flavor: The Conclave taught it to drink an enemy's borrowed power before it spends the enemy.
weapons.tip: Fast long magic single-target. No status.

weapons.name: Squirm
weapons.flavor: Squirm keeps a wriggling brood in reserve; every kill it lands hatches another hungry Larva to join the march.
weapons.tip: Epic long chaos single-target. No status.

weapons.name: Immolation Aura
weapons.flavor: Warden field-rig that wraps the tank in Foundry heat and makes the burn everyone else's problem.
weapons.tip: Rapid magic wave. Constant fire near the tank.

weapons.name: Boom Bloom
weapons.flavor: Boom Bloom scatters a tidy little garden of pop-when-touched buds across the last yard, and the front rank finds every one.
weapons.tip: Epic siege wave. Fast, brutal; stuns.

weapons.name: Quill Burst
weapons.flavor: A Warden quill-rig recovered off Ashmark, sprung once across a whole closing cluster.
weapons.tip: Long piercing splash. Sprays the cluster, no status.

weapons.name: Arcane Burst
weapons.flavor: Pure Conclave intention let off all at once, the kind of borrowing the Hexwrights regret in the morning.
weapons.tip: Long magic splash. Detonates on impact.

weapons.name: Meteor Barrage
weapons.flavor: The sky pays the Ninth Foundry's debts all at once, then makes the line wait a long time for the next installment.
weapons.tip: Epic siege barrage. Eight meteors; long reload.

weapons.name: Ale Launcher
weapons.flavor: A keg the Greycoats meant for after the Relief came, lit and thrown instead.
weapons.tip: Fast siege splash. Heals the tank.

weapons.name: Chaos Bolt
weapons.flavor: Quick mean Conclave work that goes through armor like it was never logged.
weapons.tip: Fast long chaos single-target. Ignores armor types.

weapons.name: Rotating Orb of Lightning
weapons.flavor: Hexwright lightning bound to circle the tank, and standing near it is the gunner's own decision.
weapons.tip: Wide magic pulse. Shocks everything around.

weapons.name: Lightning Generator
weapons.flavor: The Conclave wired this to hum off the enemy's own borrowed mana, and things near it stop humming.
weapons.tip: Long magic single-target. No status.

weapons.name: Flame Nova
weapons.flavor: Foundry-fire let off in a bloom, the way the front rank goes when the line finally breaks.
weapons.tip: Chaos pulse. Erupts fire around the tank.

weapons.name: Shocker
weapons.flavor: A Ninth Foundry coil that taps fast enough to leave no gap between the taps.
weapons.tip: Rapid long siege pulse. Near-constant stun-lock.

weapons.name: Tangle
weapons.flavor: Tangle throws out a snarl of sticky vine that pins a thing right where it stands and politely refuses to let go.
weapons.tip: Fast epic normal single-target. Roots the target in place.

modifiers.name: +10% Damage
modifiers.flavor: Foundry stamps this kit "general issue," the catch-all crate the Wardens hand out when nothing specialized survived the haul from Ashmark.

modifiers.name: Improved Piercing Attacks
modifiers.flavor: Hexwrights ground these heads to a finer point than the Foundry would risk, and the Wardens never asked how.

modifiers.name: Improved Siege Attacks
modifiers.flavor: Recovered from the Ashmark siege-works, calibrated for walls that fell the night the line broke.

modifiers.name: Improved Magic Attacks
modifiers.flavor: The Conclave bottles a little more of what it borrows, and signs none of it.

modifiers.name: +25% Damage (Epic)
modifiers.flavor: Foundry overrun stamped EPIC and locked in the deep vault; the Wardens were told it would never leave Ashmark.

modifiers.name: Rapidfire
modifiers.flavor: A Hexwright governor wired into the firing chain, shaving the pause the Foundry built in for safety.

modifiers.name: Bounty Hunter
modifiers.flavor: The quartermaster's ledger pays a premium per body, settled out of whatever the Greycoats strip off the field.

modifiers.name: Entangled Gold Mine
modifiers.flavor: A Hexwright-tapped seam that pays the gunner in coin and in mending both, the ledger and the surgeon settled from one vein.
modifiers.tip: Entangled Gold Mine: +20 income, 25% of it healed.

modifiers.name: +10% Gold Income
modifiers.flavor: The quartermaster skims a margin off every coin the Greycoats turn in, and the ledger never forgets.

modifiers.name: +25% Gold Income
modifiers.flavor: A heavier cut, written into the ledger by a quartermaster who stopped pretending the conscripts would be paid.

modifiers.name: Transmute
modifiers.flavor: The quartermaster keeps a crooked ledger; now and then a body settles for far more than its line was worth, and pays the premium too.
modifiers.tip: Transmute: +100% bounty; 5% of kills pay triple.

modifiers.name: Imbued Masonry
modifiers.flavor: Warden masons doubled the wall on the wall they already had, the way a siege teaches you to never stop pouring stone.

modifiers.name: +10 Armor
modifiers.flavor: Foundry hull-shave, rolled too thin in the rush but thick enough to turn what the Relief left you to face.

modifiers.name: Moonwell
modifiers.flavor: A Hexwright spring fed into the hull, the borrowed skin topping itself off the way a well does.

modifiers.name: +50 HP Regen
modifiers.flavor: The Relief that never came included field-surgeons; the Wardens improvised this drip in their absence.

modifiers.name: Evasion
modifiers.flavor: A Warden's last trick when the line is held and the Relief is a rumor: be where the blow is not.
modifiers.tip: Evasion: +10% chance to dodge a hit.

modifiers.name: Power Generator
modifiers.flavor: The longer the war drags on, the heavier the Foundry's old governor leans into the firing chain.
modifiers.tip: Power Generator: +2% damage now, +1% every round.

modifiers.name: Scroll of Chaos
modifiers.flavor: The Conclave warned that borrowed chaos compounds with every round it sits unrepaid, and The Hippocrate is still on the horizon.
modifiers.tip: Scroll of Chaos: +20% chaos now, +3% every round.

modifiers.name: Compounding Greed (+10 Income, +5/round)
modifiers.flavor: The quartermaster's ledger breeds on itself; each round the Greycoats turn in more, and the line grows fatter.

modifiers.name: Blessed Armor
modifiers.flavor: Scar over scar, the way a Warden's plating thickens every round the Relief fails to arrive.
modifiers.tip: Blessed Armor: +10 armor now, +5 every round.

modifiers.name: Focusfire
modifiers.flavor: Warden marksmanship doctrine, the kind drilled into gunners told to make every single shot count.

modifiers.name: +25% Splash Damage
modifiers.flavor: Foundry overpressure tuning meant for the crater-makers, ground for walls and the crowds behind them.

modifiers.name: +25% Barrage Damage
modifiers.flavor: Greycoat volley discipline, salvaged off a unit that fired in ranks until the ranks ran out.

modifiers.name: +25% Area Damage
modifiers.flavor: A Hexwright field-binding that thickens whatever the tank pulses out into the ring of dirt around it.

modifiers.name: Wavefire
modifiers.flavor: Calibration recovered from the Ashmark breakwalls, meant to shove a whole front rank into the next world.

modifiers.name: +25% Bounce Damage
modifiers.flavor: Foundry ricochet-work, each hop tuned to land angrier than the last off scrap nobody else would salvage.

modifiers.name: Command Aura
modifiers.flavor: Warden close-line doctrine, where the work is done at knife-reach and the gunner smells what he kills.

modifiers.name: Trueshot Aura
modifiers.flavor: A long-glass sighting kit off an Ashmark sniper-nest, for killing them before they have a face.

modifiers.name: Engineering Upgrade
modifiers.flavor: The Foundry's cheapest overruns, the junk the Greycoats are handed first, made to earn twice its serial.

modifiers.name: Bash
modifiers.flavor: Warden execution drill: a thing on the ground and stunned is a thing the line stops counting.

modifiers.name: Corrosive Poison
modifiers.flavor: Finish what the field-rations and the rot already started in them.

modifiers.name: Potent Poison
modifiers.flavor: Greycoat sickness spread through Ashmark in the bad winters; the Conclave learned to concentrate it.

modifiers.name: Dazing Stuns
modifiers.flavor: A Hexwright lock that holds the stunned a breath longer, long enough for the Wardens to work.

modifiers.name: Dreadlord Fang
modifiers.flavor: Field-improvised cruelty: Ashmark scrap-iron driven point-out into the tank's hull, set so the swing that lands draws a little back.

modifiers.name: +300 Spikes Damage
modifiers.flavor: A denser hide of welded scrap, the kind a Warden bolts on when reaching the tank should cost a limb.

modifiers.name: +50% Spikes Damage
modifiers.flavor: The same improvised barbs, ground keener by a gunner with nothing left to do but sharpen the punishment.

modifiers.name: Growing Spikes
modifiers.flavor: Every round the war drags on, the Wardens hammer fresh scrap into the hull and the welcome gets crueler.

modifiers.name: Vulnerability Totem
modifiers.flavor: A Hexwright marking-rite that opens the flesh of everything near; the marked do not heal what is opened.

modifiers.name: Mask of Death
modifiers.flavor: The Relief never came, so the Wardens took their mending off the dying and bolted fresh plate while they were at it.
modifiers.tip: Mask of Death: +1000 max HP, +15 HP per kill.

modifiers.name: +60 Heal on Kill
modifiers.flavor: A deeper draught of the same grim arithmetic, each corpse on the line paying back the Relief's debt.
modifiers.tip: +60 HP each time an enemy dies.

modifiers.name: Reanimating Poison
modifiers.flavor: Conclave rot-spores feed two mouths at once, the dying enemy's and the gunner the Relief abandoned.
modifiers.tip: Reanimating Poison: +5 HP every poison tick.

modifiers.name: Multiplication Gems
modifiers.flavor: Three flips of a Greycoat token, and the quartermaster's ledger pays out in triplicate before anyone checks the column twice.
modifiers.tip: Multiplication Gems: next common yields 3 copies.

modifiers.name: Duplicator
modifiers.flavor: The Conclave keeps a second of everything worth having, off the ledger and out of the quartermaster's count.
modifiers.tip: Duplicator: next rare bought yields 1 free copy.

modifiers.name: Black Market
modifiers.flavor: A name in the right margin of the ledger, and the Greycoats look the other way once.
modifiers.tip: Black Market: next uncommon purchase is free.

modifiers.name: Magic Treasure
modifiers.flavor: Coin the Greycoats buried at Ashmark before the line broke, dug up and still drawing interest.

modifiers.name: Ankh of Reconstruction
modifiers.flavor: The Wardens buried this rite with their last chaplain; it answers once, and resents being asked.
modifiers.tip: Ankh of Reconstruction: revive once, +2000 max HP.

modifiers.name: Healing Hand
modifiers.flavor: What field-dressing the Wardens have left, doled out by a surgeon who stopped counting the dead at Ashmark.
modifiers.tip: Healing Hand: +25% to all healing received.

modifiers.name: Living Wood
modifiers.flavor: Hexwright greenwood grown through the hull, more wall and slower mending the closer to death the gunner runs.
modifiers.tip: Living Wood: +2000 max HP, 1.5% missing HP/sec.

modifiers.name: Enchanted Moon Arrow
modifiers.flavor: Every Warden bow racked beside this one lends its draw to the next; the whole rack of them sights truer for the hoard.
modifiers.tip: Enchanted Moon Arrow: +100% piercing, +1% per Bow.

modifiers.name: Refined Explosives
modifiers.flavor: Ranged together, Foundry mortars find the old Ashmark firing tables faster, each barrel correcting the last.

modifiers.name: Overclocked Death Engine (+10% Chaos per Death Engine)
modifiers.flavor: Feed the Foundry's worst machine more of its own kind and the chaos in it deepens with the count.

modifiers.name: Philosopher's Stone
modifiers.flavor: The Greycoats will buy the meat off a living Warden, and the ledger never asks why the line went thin.

modifiers.name: Cursed Treasure
modifiers.flavor: Stop the surgeon's work, sell the bandages, and pay the quartermaster in the healing you'll never get.

modifiers.name: Bloodmoney (+1 Gold per 100 Damage)
modifiers.flavor: The Greycoats price the dead by the wound; every hundred you open is a coin in the ledger.

modifiers.name: Bloodmoney II (+1 Gold per 20 Damage)
modifiers.flavor: A richer contract from the same bloody ledger, paying out every twenty points of ruin you deal.

modifiers.name: Wartithe (25% of Income as Mana Shield)
modifiers.flavor: The Hexwrights tithe a quarter of your takings into borrowed math, keeping the skin paid up.
modifiers.tip: Income tops up your mana shield, 25%.

modifiers.name: Aegis Protocol (+2500 Shield, +400/round)
modifiers.flavor: Conclave shieldwork that studies the siege as it stands, thickening a little more each round it endures.

modifiers.name: Improved Masonry
modifiers.flavor: A patched plate off an Ashmark casualty, just enough give before the seam parts.

modifiers.name: Greater Piercing Attacks
modifiers.flavor: A spare Warden quiver, the heads honed on the same stone the last gunner used.

modifiers.name: Improved Normal Attacks
modifiers.flavor: Plain Foundry shot, no markings, no cleverness, stamped out by the crate.

modifiers.name: Improved Siege Attacks
modifiers.flavor: A Foundry overrun of siege charges, serialed for a wall at Ashmark that no longer stands.

modifiers.name: Improved Chaos Attacks
modifiers.flavor: Conclave ordnance the Hexwrights signed for but never logged, full of something that resents the barrel.

modifiers.name: +1000 Max HP
modifiers.flavor: Hull plating cut from a dead Ashmark engine, bolted over the old wounds.

modifiers.name: +10 Armor
modifiers.flavor: A Foundry armor ration, thin but stamped and accounted for in the ledger.

modifiers.name: +2000 Max HP
modifiers.flavor: Heavy Warden plate pulled off a tank that held this line three reliefs ago.

modifiers.name: +50% Kill Bounty
modifiers.flavor: The Greycoats run the corpse-tally generous when the bodies pile this high.

modifiers.name: Recharge
modifiers.flavor: A Hexwright recharging-rite for the borrowed skin, drawing the pool back up a quarter faster than it bleeds.

modifiers.name: +20 Gold Income
modifiers.flavor: A standing line in the quartermaster's ledger, paid out of Ashmark salvage each round.

modifiers.name: Tower Armor
modifiers.flavor: A scrap of Foundry plate, half a ration, glancing off what it can.

modifiers.name: +10% Attack Speed
modifiers.flavor: A Foundry gear-kit that shaves the pause between firings, cut from a faster machine.

modifiers.name: Renew
modifiers.flavor: The Wardens' field-surgeon at full pace, stitching faster than the line falls apart, and faster still as the wounds mount.

modifiers.name: Repair Crew
modifiers.flavor: A slow, stubborn mending, all the relief the Wardens could spare this post.
modifiers.tip: Repair Crew: +20 HP regen per tick.

modifiers.name: Magic Coin
modifiers.flavor: A thin trickle on the Greycoat ledger, the kind command forgets to honor.
modifiers.tip: Magic Coin: +5 gold income per round.

modifiers.name: Gold Mine
modifiers.flavor: A modest seam in the quartermaster's books, paid round on round and skimmed a margin besides.

modifiers.name: +100% Kill Bounty
modifiers.flavor: The Greycoats pay twice over for the same fallen, the ledger long past honesty.

modifiers.name: Improved Magic Attacks
modifiers.flavor: Conclave shot the Hexwrights leaned on too hard, biting back through the barrel each time.

modifiers.name: +40 HP Regen
modifiers.flavor: A respectable clip of mending, more than the Relief ever delivered to this line.

modifiers.name: Energy Shield
modifiers.flavor: An obscene coat of Hexwright life-work, more borrowed skin than any Warden was meant to wear, and it turns the blows it eats.

modifiers.name: Evasion
modifiers.flavor: A Greycoat's bad habits, learned at Ashmark: one swing in ten finds only air.
modifiers.tip: Evasion: +10% chance to dodge a hit.

modifiers.name: Escalating Plunder (+100% Bounty, +15%/round)
modifiers.flavor: The Greycoat ledger compounds as the siege drags on, the dead worth more every round The Hippocrate nears.

modifiers.name: Living Fortress (+2500 Max HP, +500/round)
modifiers.flavor: Warden salvage welded round Warden salvage, the wall thickening every round the line holds.

modifiers.name: Mana Shield
modifiers.flavor: A thin Hexwright coat of borrowed math, enough to spend before your own skin.

modifiers.name: Mending Engine (+120 Regen, +30/round)
modifiers.flavor: The Wardens' last surgeon works faster the longer the war grinds, mending quickening as the siege wears on.

modifiers.name: Mastercrafted Masonry
modifiers.flavor: Foundry masons fit the old wall to a finer tolerance than the war deserves, and the thicker it stands the harder its guns hit.
modifiers.tip: Mastercrafted Masonry: +5000 max HP, +1% damage per 2000 max HP.

modifiers.name: Golden Ring
modifiers.flavor: A Greycoat quartermaster's signet, worn smooth on the corpse-ledger; the richer the bounty it counts, the meaner the line shoots.
modifiers.tip: Golden Ring: +200% kill bounty, +1% damage per 50% bounty.

modifiers.name: Arcane Mark
modifiers.flavor: A Hexwright sigil burned into the borrowed skin; while the shield holds, every shot carries a little of that stolen fire.
modifiers.tip: Arcane Mark: +4000 mana shield, +20% damage while it holds.

modifiers.name: Maw of Death
modifiers.flavor: The Conclave fed this thing on the dying and it learned to drink; each corpse on the line tops its borrowed skin back up.
modifiers.tip: Maw of Death: +2000 mana shield, +15 shield per enemy killed.

modifiers.name: Energy Pulse
modifiers.flavor: Hexwright shielding wound so tight that when it finally fails it fails outward, a white concussion that lays the whole front rank flat.
modifiers.tip: Energy Pulse: +2000 mana shield; when it breaks, stun all enemies in 1200 for 0.5s.

modifiers.name: Poison Armor
modifiers.flavor: Greycoat sickness ground into the welds, so the swing that draws the tank's blood draws its own rot back.
modifiers.tip: Poison Armor: +10 armor, +40 spikes; retaliation also poisons.

modifiers.name: Bloody Spikes
modifiers.flavor: Each blow against the hull breaks off another barb into it; the longer the line presses, the crueler the welcome grows, until the round resets the count.
modifiers.tip: Bloody Spikes: +80 spikes; retaliation stacks more damage each hit (resets each round).

modifiers.name: Blight Aura
modifiers.flavor: A Hexwright rot-totem bolted to the tank, breathing a slow green ruin into the ground around it that the close-pressed never leave clean.
modifiers.tip: Blight Aura: +200 regen; pulse 200 poison damage in 600 every second.

weapons.name: Bow, Site-Issued
weapons.flavor: Every anchored asset is issued one. It is not anomalous, it has never been anomalous, and the fact that it keeps reappearing in the recovery log is a filing error we have stopped correcting.
weapons.tip: Single-target piercing. The object you start with; it works forever and surprises nobody.

weapons.name: Requisitioned Mortar
weapons.flavor: Ordered by Facilities to clear a blockage on Sub-Level 2. There was no blockage on Sub-Level 2. There is now no Sub-Level 2.
weapons.tip: Long-range siege splash. Wide blast, slow to reload.

weapons.name: Cold Locker Bow
weapons.flavor: Left at the back of the specimen freezer for eleven years. It is now the freezer, and the freezer is now a bow.
weapons.tip: Fast single-target magic. 7 frost a hit — four hits reach the freeze at 25.

weapons.name: Bow, Contaminated
weapons.flavor: Cleared for use by Medical on the grounds that whatever coats the tips is already in the water supply, so issuing it is not an additional exposure.
weapons.tip: Single-target piercing. Light hit, heavy 3-second poison.

weapons.name: Ignition Sprayer
weapons.flavor: Recovered from a staff kitchen with no gas line, no power, and — per the floor plan filed with the county — no door.
weapons.tip: Short-range chaos splash. 6 fire a hit; burning things take more damage and detonate when they die.

weapons.name: Grounding Rod (Do Not Hold)
weapons.flavor: Safe to operate from behind the yellow line. The yellow line is repainted weekly and has never twice been in the same place.
weapons.tip: Heavy single-target magic. 1.5-second stun on the target.

weapons.name: Four-Bolt Rig
weapons.flavor: Assembled overnight from shelving brackets against a work order that no department at this site submitted, and that Procurement has paid twice.
weapons.tip: Long-range siege barrage. Four bolts, four separate targets.

weapons.name: Ambient Combustion Field
weapons.flavor: The thermostat on this level will not go below forty-one degrees. Maintenance have logged it as a comfort issue and closed the ticket.
weapons.tip: Chaos pulse around the anchor. 2 fire to everything close, every second.

weapons.name: Groundskeeper's Axe
weapons.flavor: The handle is worn into a grip pattern that matches no hand on file, including the groundskeeper's, including the groundskeeper's after.
weapons.tip: Point-blank sweep. Huge hit on everything near; no status applied.

weapons.name: Returning Disc
weapons.flavor: It comes back. Personnel are reminded that the object comes back, that it has always come back, and that leaving the building does not constitute an exemption.
weapons.tip: Piercing chain. Instantly strikes four nearby enemies.

weapons.name: Duplicating Apparatus
weapons.flavor: Procurement approved further units on the reasoning that we already have several. That is the same reasoning that produced the several.
weapons.tip: Single-target chaos. Unremarkable alone — it compounds only with the retrofit that pays +10% chaos per Apparatus owned.

weapons.name: Standard Emitter
weapons.flavor: Emits. That is the whole assessment. Three researchers spent a quarter on it and the finished report is one word long.
weapons.tip: Single-target normal damage. Plain, cheap, dependable.

weapons.name: The Rock From Outside
weapons.flavor: It was in the car park. It is now in the inventory. Nobody moved it, and the inventory is not taking questions.
weapons.tip: Single-target siege. A rock, thrown. No status.

weapons.name: Baseline Discharge Unit
weapons.flavor: Issued to trainees because it does exactly one thing, and in nine years no trainee has found a second thing.
weapons.tip: Single-target magic. Quick, plain hit.

weapons.name: Unlabelled Sphere
weapons.flavor: Intake lost the tag. Nobody has been willing to write a replacement, because writing a tag requires deciding what it is.
weapons.tip: Single-target chaos. Chaos ignores armour class entirely.

weapons.name: Hatchet Set (Incomplete)
weapons.flavor: Catalogued as a set of six. Six are present at every count. There have only ever been three.
weapons.tip: Short-range piercing chain. Fast, hits three.

weapons.name: Cranial Remnants, Boxed
weapons.flavor: Filed under office supplies, because the box they arrived in was filed under office supplies, and here we go by the box.
weapons.tip: Chaos chain. Bounces between three targets.

weapons.name: The Thing In The Vending Machine
weapons.flavor: Sub-Level 3 breakroom, slot C4, since at least 2011. It takes exact change and it gives back something warm.
weapons.tip: Point-blank chaos sweep. Slow, but repairs the anchor 40 per enemy hit.

weapons.name: Ordnance Rack, Sub-Level 9
weapons.flavor: Sub-Level 9 appears on no evacuation map, no lift panel and no part of the building's legal description, and it is fully stocked.
weapons.tip: Epic long-range barrage. Eight bolts, each stunning for 3 seconds.

weapons.name: Axe That Finds You
weapons.flavor: The name is Recovery's. Recovery name things badly and then defend the name at meetings, at length, with slides.
weapons.tip: Long-range piercing chain. Bounces to three.

weapons.name: Boiler Tap
weapons.flavor: There is no boiler. The tap is plumbed into something on the far side of the wall that has been quietly paying our heating bill for years.
weapons.tip: Short-range siege splash. Brief half-second stun.

weapons.name: Observation Lens
weapons.flavor: It shows you whatever you are already looking at, one second early. That is only useful if you are willing to accept what it implies about the second.
weapons.tip: Heavy single-target chaos. Each hit leaves +10% damage taken, stacking permanently.

weapons.name: Pinning Spike
weapons.flavor: Supplied with a laminated card explaining its purpose. The card has been laminated four times, each time over a different explanation.
weapons.tip: Fast single-target piercing. Short stun on every hit.

weapons.name: Swarm, Contained (Loosely)
weapons.flavor: The containment is a mason jar. It has held nine years, and Engineering have stopped requesting an upgrade in case the jar hears about it.
weapons.tip: Long-range chaos splash. Spreads on impact.

weapons.name: Loading Arm, Bay 2
weapons.flavor: Built to move pallets. Retrained in an afternoon by a temp who is no longer with us and, on review of the roster, never was.
weapons.tip: Short-range siege single-target. Heavy, no status.

weapons.name: Open Hand, Enormous
weapons.flavor: Manifests, delivers one slap, unmanifests. Psychology assess the humiliation as the primary hazard and the concussion as secondary.
weapons.tip: Epic single-target piercing. Enormous hit, and knocks the target back 300.

weapons.name: Load-Bearing Injury
weapons.flavor: What it takes off does not grow back, and the paperwork maintains it was never there, which makes the claim extraordinarily difficult to file.
weapons.tip: Heavy single-target piercing. Leaves +8% damage taken, stacking permanently.

weapons.name: Transfusion Line
weapons.flavor: Approved by Medical on the strict condition that nobody ask which direction it was originally built to run.
weapons.tip: Long-range single-target. Repairs the anchor 40 per enemy hit.

weapons.name: Idea With An Edge
weapons.flavor: Reading the intake summary constitutes exposure. You have now read part of the intake summary.
weapons.tip: Magic chain. Carves through four.

weapons.name: Blade Feeder
weapons.flavor: Refuses to lie flat, refuses to stay in the drawer, and has otherwise given us no trouble whatsoever.
weapons.tip: Normal chain. Bounces to three.

weapons.name: Wheel, Still Rolling
weapons.flavor: It has not stopped since intake. We built the storage rack around it rather than the other way about.
weapons.tip: Long-range siege chain. Rolls through six.

weapons.name: Organic Payload Sling
weapons.flavor: The requisition form has a field for the payload. The field has been blank since 2014 and the sling has never once been empty.
weapons.tip: Normal splash. Heavy impact, 2-second stun.

weapons.name: Discharge Wand, Serviced
weapons.flavor: Serviced quarterly by a contractor whose invoices arrive, whose work is plainly done, and whose company has no registration anywhere.
weapons.tip: Single-target magic. 1.5-second stun on hit.

weapons.name: Quill, Shed
weapons.flavor: Found in the corridor carpet. We have nothing on the manifest that sheds. We have been through the manifest twice.
weapons.tip: Single-target piercing. Light poison for 3 seconds.

weapons.name: Expectorant Sample
weapons.flavor: Still warm at every inspection, including the 04:00 inspections, which nobody schedules and which are always attended.
weapons.tip: Single-target magic. Trickling 3-second poison.

weapons.name: Canister, Vented
weapons.flavor: Vented deliberately. The alternative was leaving it sealed, and the seal had begun making requests.
weapons.tip: Long-range siege splash. Poisons the whole blast.

weapons.name: The Long Occupant
weapons.flavor: Lives in the ductwork by preference and is, by every metric Facilities track, an exemplary tenant.
weapons.tip: Single-target normal. One bite, then a strong 3-second poison.

weapons.name: Loading Arm, Overridden
weapons.flavor: The safety limit was a number in a text file. Somebody changed the number. The arm required no further persuasion.
weapons.tip: Short-range siege splash. Bigger rock, bigger hole.

weapons.name: Reaching Limb
weapons.flavor: Extends from a wall cavity on request. It has not been established whose request, and it is not always ours.
weapons.tip: Single-target chaos. 1.5-second stun.

weapons.name: Retrieval Net
weapons.flavor: Standard Recovery kit. Rated for objects up to nine feet, up to four limbs, and up to one apology.
weapons.tip: Fast long-range single-target. Tangling stun on hit.

weapons.name: Floor Growth, Untreated
weapons.flavor: Grounds decline to treat it on the basis that it reacts only to trespass, and staff are not trespassers on most days.
weapons.tip: Wide piercing pulse. Hits everything within 400 of the anchor.

weapons.name: Recording, Still Playing
weapons.flavor: The tape ran out in 1998 and the machine has been unplugged since. It is a very long scream and it has structure.
weapons.tip: Epic magic chain. Wails through eight targets.

weapons.name: Discharge, Facility-Wide
weapons.flavor: Every two and a half seconds the lights dim, the fillings ache, and one problem stops moving.
weapons.tip: Point-blank magic sweep. Wide hit, 2-second stun.

weapons.name: Twelve Small Problems
weapons.flavor: Requisitioned as one problem. Delivered as twelve. Procurement regard this as within tolerance and have filed it under resolved.
weapons.tip: Long-range chaos barrage. Twelve warheads at scattered targets.

weapons.name: Chill Charge
weapons.flavor: Detonation drops the local temperature by forty degrees and the local morale by rather more.
weapons.tip: Fast piercing splash. 3 frost across the cluster.

weapons.name: Ball That Will Not Settle
weapons.flavor: Left in the east stairwell in 2007 as a temporary measure. It has been going down the stairs ever since.
weapons.tip: Normal chain. Four hops, each stunning for 3 seconds.

weapons.name: Withdrawal Instrument
weapons.flavor: It takes something. It returns something. There is no evidence the two are the same thing and a considerable file suggesting they are not.
weapons.tip: Epic chain to four. Repairs the anchor 200 per enemy hit.

weapons.name: Bucket, Anomalous
weapons.flavor: A bucket. Anomalous only in that it is never empty, which is why Procurement have stopped ordering buckets and started ordering explanations.
weapons.tip: Fast normal splash. Rapid small bursts, no status.

weapons.name: Kindling Rack
weapons.flavor: The arrows are ordinary. The rack is not, and the rack is where they learn.
weapons.tip: Piercing barrage. Four shots, each adding 4 fire.

weapons.name: Structural Webbing
weapons.flavor: Engineering have confirmed it is now load-bearing and have revised the building's safety rating upward on the strength of it.
weapons.tip: Chaos chain through six. Leaves a light poison.

weapons.name: Grasping Field, Close
weapons.flavor: Effective within arm's reach, which is the range at which most incidents here are resolved and all of them begin.
weapons.tip: Short-range magic chain to four. Restores 20 shield per enemy hit.

weapons.name: Ladle, Sub-Level 4
weapons.flavor: Sub-Level 4 contains a crucible nobody built, drawing power nobody bills, and exactly one implement long enough to reach it.
weapons.tip: Very fast siege single-target. 4 fire and +3% damage taken per hit.

weapons.name: Masonry, Displaced
weapons.flavor: The wall it came out of is intact. We hold photographs of both facts and no reconciliation of them.
weapons.tip: Point-blank normal splash. Leaves +5% damage taken, stacking.

weapons.name: The Floor Of Room 12
weapons.flavor: Room 12 is a storage room. The floor of Room 12 is an event. We continue to store things in Room 12.
weapons.tip: Epic point-blank sweep. Heavy hit, 1-second stun on everything caught.

weapons.name: Bloom Event, Contained
weapons.flavor: The bloom is contained. What the bloom leaves standing is not contained, but it is on our side, which Legal insist is a different form entirely.
weapons.tip: Epic chaos pulse. Massive hit, 60 fire, 2-second stun — and every kill raises a spore ally.

weapons.name: Furnace, Unlicensed
weapons.flavor: Runs on nothing, vents into nothing, and has been quietly heating six floors and one corridor that does not appear on the plans.
weapons.tip: Epic magic pulse. Buries a pack in 200 fire stacks — the death-explosions do the rest.

weapons.name: Exhaust Port, Repurposed
weapons.flavor: It was venting outward the entire time. We have only recently established which side is outward.
weapons.tip: Fast piercing splash. 5 fire and +5% damage taken per hit.

weapons.name: Deep Tap
weapons.flavor: Drilled to sixty metres for geothermal. What came up is hotter than geothermal and has developed views about the drill.
weapons.tip: Epic long-range siege splash. 150 fire stacks a shell.

weapons.name: Sliver, Cold
weapons.flavor: A single shard off something larger that we have never located, fired repeatedly at things we would prefer not to locate either.
weapons.tip: Fast piercing single-target. 5 frost a hit, toward the freeze at 25.

weapons.name: Ice That Spreads
weapons.flavor: It does not melt, it relocates, and it has been relocating toward the server room since March at a rate Facilities describe as deliberate.
weapons.tip: Magic splash. Spreads 2 frost on impact.

weapons.name: Cold Plant
weapons.flavor: Rated to chill one floor. Chills nine. The other eight are not in this building and have not been identified.
weapons.tip: Epic magic pulse. 5 frost across a 375 radius — mass freezes.

weapons.name: Spear Rack, Cold Store
weapons.flavor: Counted by the dozen, issued by the four, and never once has the arithmetic satisfied anybody who checked it.
weapons.tip: Normal barrage. Four hits, 5 frost each.

weapons.name: Cutlery, Site
weapons.flavor: Requisitioned for the canteen. Recategorised after the canteen incident, which was, in fairness to Procurement, a cutlery incident.
weapons.tip: Fast piercing barrage. Three blades, no status.

weapons.name: Percussive Tool
weapons.flavor: Maintenance's preferred instrument. Maintenance's only instrument. Maintenance have never opened a ticket they could not close.
weapons.tip: Fast siege single-target. Leaves +5% damage taken.

weapons.name: Rifle, Recovered From The Fence Line
weapons.flavor: The scope is sighted on something eleven hundred metres out. There is nothing eleven hundred metres out. The scope disagrees, patiently.
weapons.tip: Fast long-range single-target. Marks the target for +5% damage taken.

weapons.name: Charges, Handled Casually
weapons.flavor: Carried by the crate, lobbed underhand, and never once looked back at — which is written into the procedure as step four.
weapons.tip: Short-range siege splash. Brief half-second stun.

weapons.name: Small Offended Thing
weapons.flavor: Three centimetres long and deeply personal about it. Whatever it stings stops being able to shrug anything off, ever again.
weapons.tip: Long-range chaos single-target. +10% damage taken a hit, stacking permanently.

weapons.name: Cranial Charge
weapons.flavor: Somebody's, packed with somebody else's, and countersigned by a third party who declined to be named on the form.
weapons.tip: Chaos splash. Bursts and stuns for 1.5 seconds.

weapons.name: Cold Exhale
weapons.flavor: Recorded once at intake as a sigh. Nothing at this site was breathing at the time of the recording, and the recording is four minutes long.
weapons.tip: Siege splash. Frosts the blast and leaves +4% damage taken.

weapons.name: Corridor Chill
weapons.flavor: Crosses the length of a corridor in one pass. The corridor is longer on some nights, and the pass takes exactly as long.
weapons.tip: Point-blank magic sweep. Sweeps wide, 3 frost.

weapons.name: Rolling Burn
weapons.flavor: Fire safety have signed it off on the grounds that it always travels away from the exits, which is more than can be said for anything else here.
weapons.tip: Point-blank sweep. 20 fire stacks and +6% damage taken.

weapons.name: Flicker
weapons.flavor: Present in one frame of every security recording. Always nearer, always facing the camera, always feeding us a little on the way past.
weapons.tip: Very fast chaos single-target. Repairs the anchor 40 per hit.

weapons.name: Siphon Bolt
weapons.flavor: Takes whatever the target was running on. Personnel are advised that this category includes personnel.
weapons.tip: Very fast long-range magic. Restores 80 shield per enemy hit.

weapons.name: Brood Jar
weapons.flavor: The jar holds a fixed number. The number is fixed at whatever you last counted, and while you count it counts back.
weapons.tip: Epic long-range chaos. Every kill it lands hatches a larva ally.

weapons.name: Warm Perimeter
weapons.flavor: Personnel report that standing near the anchor is pleasant in February and, by August, a disciplinary matter.
weapons.tip: Rapid magic sweep. Constant small fire and +3% damage taken.

weapons.name: Seed Bed
weapons.flavor: Grounds planted it as ground cover. It is excellent ground cover. Nothing has crossed it and nothing has been recovered from it.
weapons.tip: Epic point-blank sweep. 3-second stun, and drops a mine field burning 1000 a tick for 3 seconds.

weapons.name: Quill Discharge
weapons.flavor: Fires once, across an entire approaching group. Whatever it is defending itself from, it has decided that we count.
weapons.tip: Long-range piercing splash. Sprays the cluster for +10% damage taken.

weapons.name: Intent, Released
weapons.flavor: Held eleven years in a lead box on the theory that intent obeys lead. It did, right up until the annual review, which it attended.
weapons.tip: Long-range magic splash. Detonates and leaves +10% damage taken.

weapons.name: Overhead Delivery
weapons.flavor: The site holds no airspace clearance and no delivery contract. The site holds a receiving log, and the receiving log is full.
weapons.tip: Epic siege barrage. Eight impacts, then a very long four-second reload.

weapons.name: Keg, Breakroom
weapons.flavor: Nobody stocked it, nobody drinks from it, and everyone who walks past feels marginally better about the corridor.
weapons.tip: Fast siege splash. Trickles 4 HP back per enemy hit.

weapons.name: Quick Unpleasantness
weapons.flavor: Assessed as anomalous, hazardous and rude. Only two of those have a box on the form, so it is filed as rude.
weapons.tip: Very fast long-range chaos. Chaos ignores armour class.

weapons.name: Orbiting Fixture
weapons.flavor: It circles the anchor at head height. Standing at head height near the anchor is, and has always been, a personal choice.
weapons.tip: Wide magic pulse. Hits everything within 600, every second.

weapons.name: Draw-Down Coil
weapons.flavor: Wired to hum off whatever the target is using to keep going. Things near it stop humming, and shortly after that they stop.
weapons.tip: Long-range magic single-target. Restores 20 shield per hit.

weapons.name: Bloom, Thermal
weapons.flavor: Opens outward roughly every second. Fire safety attend, observe, and file the identical sentence each time.
weapons.tip: Chaos pulse. 20 fire and +6% damage taken to everything close.

weapons.name: Mains Fault, Persistent
weapons.flavor: Reported in 2009. Ticket still open. The ticket is the only thing keeping this level's population down.
weapons.tip: Rapid siege pulse. 2-second stuns, fast enough to lock a crowd down.

weapons.name: Holdfast Vine
weapons.flavor: It does not want to hurt anything. It wants everything to stay exactly where it is, permanently, and it is patient about the difference.
weapons.tip: Fast epic single-target. Roots the target for 1 second — a root, so +% Stun Duration does not extend it.

modifiers.name: Blanket Efficacy Memo
modifiers.flavor: A one-page memo instructing every catalogued object to try ten per cent harder. It is not clear why this works. It is extremely clear that it works.

modifiers.name: Sharpening Rota
modifiers.flavor: Every edged object in the register goes through the wheel on Tuesdays. Two of them go through it unaccompanied.

modifiers.name: Demolition Clearance
modifiers.flavor: Standing permission to remove load-bearing walls. Structural have stopped objecting, largely because Structural have stopped.

modifiers.name: Field Recalibration
modifiers.flavor: Ten per cent more of whatever the meters measure. Nobody currently at this site can tell you what the meters measure.

modifiers.name: Sanction: Unrestricted
modifiers.flavor: One sheet, countersigned by an office that does not answer its telephone, lifting every remaining limit in the register at once.
modifiers.tip: ×1.25 damage — multiplicative, on top of everything else.

modifiers.name: Duty Cycle Override
modifiers.flavor: The pause between firings was a safety feature. It was documented as a safety feature. It has been shortened.

modifiers.name: Salvage Rights, Extended
modifiers.flavor: Whatever comes down the corridor becomes, contractually, yours the moment it stops moving.

modifiers.name: Payroll Splice
modifiers.flavor: A quarter of the money goes to the anchor's repairs and the repairs go somewhere else. Accounting have drawn a diagram. The diagram loops.
modifiers.tip: +20 passive gold per tick; 25% of every income payout also repairs you.

modifiers.name: Requisition Cycle: Shortened
modifiers.flavor: Filed as a ten per cent improvement. It is twenty. The clerk responsible has been promoted twice on the strength of the discrepancy.

modifiers.name: Requisition Cycle: Aggressive
modifiers.flavor: Same clerk. Same discrepancy. Larger.

modifiers.name: Assay Bench
modifiers.flavor: Weighs the remains, prices them, and now and then decides a body was worth vastly more than the bench can account for.
modifiers.tip: +100% kill bounty; 5% of kills pay a further +200% of base bounty.

modifiers.name: Poured Reinforcement
modifiers.flavor: Concrete over concrete over the original concrete. The original is still in there and is still the part that holds.
modifiers.tip: +2000 max HP, then +25% of max HP on top.

modifiers.name: Plate Retrofit
modifiers.flavor: Bolted on during a night shift with no work order, no sign-off, and no complaints since.
modifiers.tip: +10 flat armour — shaved off every incoming hit.

modifiers.name: Reservoir Tap
modifiers.flavor: Something beneath the site refills faster than we can draw from it. We have stopped treating this as good news.

modifiers.name: Standing Repair Order
modifiers.flavor: Maintenance are now permanently assigned to the anchor. They have moved a cot in. They have not been seen upright since.

modifiers.name: Displacement Tolerance
modifiers.flavor: The anchor is anchored. It is nonetheless, occasionally, measurably not where the hit lands.
modifiers.tip: +10% chance to avoid a hit entirely (dodge caps at 70%).

modifiers.name: Generator, Warming Up
modifiers.flavor: Output climbs the longer it runs. The manual gives no ceiling, only a recommendation, and the recommendation is a wish.

modifiers.name: Standing Wave Notice
modifiers.flavor: Chaos compounds while it goes unpaid. This is not a metaphor; it is on the notice, in bold, above a telephone number.
modifiers.tip: +20% chaos damage now, +3% more every 30 seconds.

modifiers.name: Interest Accrual Clause
modifiers.flavor: Buried in the site's lease. Nobody has identified the lessor, but they are being paid and we are being paid more.
modifiers.tip: +10 passive gold per tick, +5 more every 30 seconds.

modifiers.name: Scar Tissue Protocol
modifiers.flavor: The plating thickens where it has been hit before, which means the anchor is slowly becoming a map of its worst nights.

modifiers.name: Single-Subject Doctrine
modifiers.flavor: Section Nine hold that a facility with one problem at a time is a facility with a future.

modifiers.name: Overpressure Waiver
modifiers.flavor: Signed on the understanding that the blast will exceed the room, and that the room was, on reflection, optional.

modifiers.name: Volley Discipline Course
modifiers.flavor: Two days, catered. The catering is the part personnel remember, and the part the incident report concerns itself with.

modifiers.name: Perimeter Saturation Order
modifiers.flavor: Everything within arm's reach of the anchor is redesignated an active surface. Signage is pending.

modifiers.name: Corridor Sweep Authorisation
modifiers.flavor: Authorises one clean pass down the corridor, end to end, without stopping to identify what is in it.

modifiers.name: Ricochet Study, Applied
modifiers.flavor: Three years of research into why things here come back angrier, distilled into a checkbox on a form.

modifiers.name: Close-Quarters Certification
modifiers.flavor: Certifies personnel to work within six hundred units of an active problem. The certification is one afternoon long.
modifiers.tip: +25% damage for weapons with range 600 or less.

modifiers.name: Standoff Doctrine
modifiers.flavor: The site's official position is that anything worth looking at is worth looking at from further away.
modifiers.tip: +25% damage for weapons with range over 600.

modifiers.name: Cheap Stock Reappraisal
modifiers.flavor: The bottom shelf was re-surveyed after somebody noticed it had been doing most of the work. It had been, and it is furious.
modifiers.tip: Doubles the damage of every Common weapon.

modifiers.name: Downed-Subject Procedure
modifiers.flavor: Step one: confirm it is down. Step two: continue. There is no step three and there has never needed to be.

modifiers.name: Follow-Up Exposure Policy
modifiers.flavor: Finishes what the water supply began. Medical have stopped attending the review meetings and have stopped sending apologies.

modifiers.name: Concentrate, Undiluted
modifiers.flavor: The dilution step existed for the handler's benefit, not the subject's, and the handler has been reassigned.
modifiers.tip: +10% to the poison damage your weapons apply.

modifiers.name: Extended Hold Order
modifiers.flavor: Authorises keeping a subject still for half again as long, on grounds nobody has been asked to write down.

modifiers.name: Barbed Cladding
modifiers.flavor: Anything that reaches the anchor leaves a little of itself behind, and the anchor has learned to make use of it.
modifiers.tip: +80 retaliation damage when hit, and +8 HP repaired each time a hit lands on you.

modifiers.name: Hostile Surface Treatment
modifiers.flavor: Applied by contractors in full suits who declined to explain the suits and who left the tins behind.

modifiers.name: Barb Sharpening Schedule
modifiers.flavor: Weekly. Carried out by an operator with nothing else to do and a growing amount of feeling about it.

modifiers.name: Accretion Notice
modifiers.flavor: The cladding is not maintained. It accumulates. Facilities have reclassified it from equipment to geology.

modifiers.name: Field Marker, Wide
modifiers.flavor: Everything inside the marker is logged as already injured. The logging appears to be doing the work.
modifiers.tip: Enemies within 1200 take +5% more damage each second, stacking without limit.

modifiers.name: Attrition Ledger
modifiers.flavor: Each death out in the corridor is entered as a credit against the anchor's condition. The ledger balances. That is the troubling part.
modifiers.tip: +1000 max HP, and +15 HP repaired per enemy killed.

modifiers.name: Deep Attrition Clause
modifiers.flavor: The same arithmetic, four times as generous, and nobody has established where the surplus is coming from.
modifiers.tip: +60 HP repaired each time an enemy dies.

modifiers.name: Reclamation Culture
modifiers.flavor: The culture feeds on whatever it is dissolving and posts the difference back to us, warm, at intervals.
modifiers.tip: +5 HP repaired every tick an enemy is taking poison damage.

modifiers.name: Clerical Error, Favourable
modifiers.flavor: The next common requisition will be filled four times. The clerk responsible has been commended and cannot be located.
modifiers.tip: Your next Common purchase arrives with 3 extra free copies.

modifiers.name: Duplicate Filing
modifiers.flavor: Everything worth having is filed twice here — one copy for the register, one for whatever reads the register at night.
modifiers.tip: Your next Rare purchase arrives with 1 extra free copy.

modifiers.name: Off-Ledger Requisition
modifiers.flavor: A name written in the margin, and one item leaves the receiving bay without ever having arrived at it.
modifiers.tip: Your next Uncommon purchase costs nothing.

modifiers.name: Petty Cash Tin (Sealed)
modifiers.flavor: Two hundred and fifty on opening, and it keeps quietly getting heavier on the shelf, which is why it was sealed.
modifiers.tip: +250 gold immediately, and +5 passive income every 30 seconds.

modifiers.name: Continuity Provision
modifiers.flavor: Guarantees the site remains staffed. It does not specify by whom, and it may be invoked exactly once.
modifiers.tip: One revive: on a fatal hit, fully repair and gain +2000 max HP instead of dying.

modifiers.name: Medical Escalation
modifiers.flavor: Everything the anchor is given now goes further. Medical are reluctant to explain why they had been holding back.

modifiers.name: Growth, Structural
modifiers.flavor: Something is growing through the anchor's plating. It closes the worst wounds fastest, which is precisely how a parasite would behave.
modifiers.tip: +2000 max HP, and heals 1.5% of missing HP every second.

modifiers.name: Fletching Standard, Revised
modifiers.flavor: Every bow in the register now shares one specification, and specifications here have a way of noticing one another.
modifiers.tip: +100% piercing damage, and +1% more for every Bow, Site-Issued you own.

modifiers.name: Firing Tables, Consolidated
modifiers.flavor: One table for every mortar on site. Each barrel corrects the last, and the last one has never been fired by anyone we can name.
modifiers.tip: +100% siege damage, and +1% more for every Requisitioned Mortar you own.

modifiers.name: Duplication Consent Form
modifiers.flavor: Signing it permits the apparatus to acknowledge its own copies. They have been aware of one another for some time; the form is a courtesy.
modifiers.tip: +10% chaos damage for every Duplicating Apparatus you own.

modifiers.name: Asset Stripping Order
modifiers.flavor: Sells a thousand points of the anchor's structure to a buyer who never visits and who always pays on time.

modifiers.name: Maintenance Contract, Terminated
modifiers.flavor: Five thousand up front, and the repair crew are escorted out through the corridor, which is the clause nobody reads.
modifiers.tip: Free. -100 HP regen per tick (this can go negative and drain you), +5000 gold.

modifiers.name: Damage Invoicing
modifiers.flavor: Every point of harm done in this building is billed to somebody. We have stopped asking who settles it.
modifiers.tip: Earn 1 gold per 60 damage you deal.

modifiers.name: Damage Invoicing, Itemised
modifiers.flavor: The same arrangement, line by line, and the payer has never once queried an item.
modifiers.tip: Earn 1 gold per 12 damage you deal.

modifiers.name: Withholding, Protective
modifiers.flavor: A quarter of every payment is diverted into the anchor's field before it reaches the account. Nobody set this up.
modifiers.tip: 25% of every income payout also tops up your shield.

modifiers.name: Escalating Containment Field
modifiers.flavor: The field studies each siege as it happens and comes back thicker. It has been studying for a considerable time.
modifiers.tip: +2500 shield (20 a tick), growing +400 more every 30 seconds.

modifiers.name: Patch Plate
modifiers.flavor: Cut from a plate that was itself a patch. There is a seam under the seam, and it is holding.

modifiers.name: Spare Quiver, Bonded
modifiers.flavor: Stored beside the first one and honed on the same stone. The two are now difficult to tell apart in the dark, and increasingly in daylight.

modifiers.name: Unremarkable Ordnance Uplift
modifiers.flavor: No markings, no anomaly, no file. Simply more of it, hitting harder — the site's oldest and least respected strategy.

modifiers.name: Charge Weight Increase
modifiers.flavor: Approved by raising the number on a form until nobody with authority was still reading the form.

modifiers.name: Unclassified Ordnance Release
modifiers.flavor: Signed for with a single initial. The initial corresponds to nobody on the roster, and the crates went out regardless.

modifiers.name: Hull Section, Salvaged
modifiers.flavor: Cut off an anchor that stopped answering on Sub-Level 6 and welded over the anchor that still does.

modifiers.name: Armour Ration
modifiers.flavor: One issue per anchor per quarter. Thin, stamped, accounted for, and the only thing between you and the quarter.

modifiers.name: Heavy Plate Allocation
modifiers.flavor: Pulled off an anchor that held this corridor through three incidents and is not available for comment on any of them.

modifiers.name: Body Count Premium
modifiers.flavor: Accounting run the tally generous when the tally gets this long. It is cheaper than the alternative form.

modifiers.name: Field Recharge Cycle
modifiers.flavor: Draws the pool back up a quarter faster than it drains, which is a comfortable margin right up until it is not.
modifiers.tip: +2000 shield (10 a tick), then +25% to shield regeneration.

modifiers.name: Standing Salvage Line
modifiers.flavor: A line item that pays out every tick, funded from a budget code that appears in no budget.

modifiers.name: Scrap Facing
modifiers.flavor: Half a ration of plate, applied wherever the last incident report said the hits were landing.

modifiers.name: Gear Kit, Salvaged
modifiers.flavor: Taken out of something faster and fitted to something that had not asked to be faster.

modifiers.name: Repair Crew, Doubled
modifiers.flavor: Two shifts stitching at once. They work quicker as the damage mounts, which everyone has agreed not to find strange.
modifiers.tip: +80 HP regen per tick, then +25% on top of your regen.

modifiers.name: Repair Crew, One
modifiers.flavor: One man, one trolley, the entire corridor. He is very calm about it and has been here longer than the corridor.

modifiers.name: Coin, Returned
modifiers.flavor: It spends, and it is back in the tin by morning. Finance have written it off eleven times.

modifiers.name: Seam, Modest
modifiers.flavor: A small opening in the floor of the receiving bay that pays a little and takes a percentage of interest in you.
modifiers.tip: +10 passive gold per tick, and +10% to passive income.

modifiers.name: Double Indemnity Schedule
modifiers.flavor: Every body pays twice. The schedule does not explain the second payment and Accounting have stopped asking it to.

modifiers.name: Emitter Tuning Pass
modifiers.flavor: Ten per cent more output at the cost of a hum that personnel describe, in the anonymous survey, as expectant.

modifiers.name: Supplementary Repair Allocation
modifiers.flavor: More than this corridor has ever been allocated, which is why it arrived without a covering note or a requesting department.

modifiers.name: Full Envelope
modifiers.flavor: The anchor disappears inside its own field. Personnel report that it is quieter in there, and that it is not empty.
modifiers.tip: +10000 shield (50 a tick), and -30% to ALL damage taken while the shield holds.

modifiers.name: Bad Habits, Institutional
modifiers.flavor: The anchor has learned when not to quite be there. Nobody taught it and nobody has filed the observation.
modifiers.tip: +10% chance to dodge a hit (dodge caps at 70%).

modifiers.name: Indexed Bounty Schedule
modifiers.flavor: Payments rise with the length of the incident. The incident has no defined end, and the schedule has no defined ceiling.
modifiers.tip: +100% kill bounty now, +15% more every 30 seconds.

modifiers.name: Continuous Pour
modifiers.flavor: The concrete never stops arriving. Nobody drives the trucks, and the trucks are punctual.

modifiers.name: Thin Envelope
modifiers.flavor: Enough field to spend before the plating has to. Medical call it a buffer. Personnel call it first.

modifiers.name: Repair Loop, Self-Improving
modifiers.flavor: It gets better at the job the longer the job goes on. It is the only thing on site that does, and it is being watched closely.
modifiers.tip: +120 HP regen per tick, +30 more every 30 seconds.

modifiers.name: Load-Bearing Doctrine
modifiers.flavor: The site engineer determined that a wall, made thick enough, becomes a weapon. He was correct, and he has been reassigned.
modifiers.tip: +5000 max HP, and +1% damage for every 2000 max HP you have — recalculated live.

modifiers.name: Procurement Signet
modifiers.flavor: Worn smooth on the body ledger. The richer the count it keeps, the meaner the register becomes about keeping it.
modifiers.tip: +200% kill bounty, and +1% damage for every 50% bounty above base.

modifiers.name: Sigil, Etched Inward
modifiers.flavor: Cut into the inner face of the field housing, pointing at the anchor. While the field holds, the anchor hits like whatever put it there.
modifiers.tip: +4000 shield (20 a tick), and +20% damage while the shield is up.

modifiers.name: Intake, Reversed
modifiers.flavor: The field was built to keep things out. At some point it began accepting deliveries, and it has been eating well.
modifiers.tip: +2000 shield (10 a tick), and +15 shield restored per enemy killed.

modifiers.name: Failure Mode, Documented
modifiers.flavor: When the field fails, it fails outward. This was discovered rather than designed, and subsequently written up as a feature.
modifiers.tip: +2000 shield (10 a tick); when it breaks, stun everything within 1200 for half a second.

modifiers.name: Septic Cladding
modifiers.flavor: The welds were never cleaned. Everything that opens the anchor takes a little of the corridor home with it.
modifiers.tip: +10 armour, +40 retaliation; retaliation also poisons for 3 seconds.

modifiers.name: Embedded Debris
modifiers.flavor: Each blow leaves more of the previous blow in the surface. It clears at the shift change, which is the only reason anyone survives the shift.
modifiers.tip: +80 retaliation; every hit you take adds +20 more, up to +500. Resets each round.

modifiers.name: Atmosphere, Adjusted
modifiers.flavor: The air around the anchor is now within tolerance for the anchor and well outside it for everything else. Signage is, again, pending.
modifiers.tip: +200 HP regen per tick; every second, 200 damage plus poison to everything within 600.
